claims.text: The driver's own GPS trace never places him inside the 150 m arrival radius for the TRANSPORT_HUB pickup at any point: the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds, so POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable.

Even measured against the driver's closest approach, the trace never gets near the pin: the driver's minimum distance to the pickup is 517.4 m, which is beyond the 400 m wrong-entrance ceiling, so this is not a POL-NS-03 wrong-face-of-the-venue case but a driver who never arrived at the pickup at all.

The effective in-geofence dwell is 0.0 seconds against the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip, a shortfall of 180 seconds, so under POL-NS-06 the cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full whether or not the rider was present.

The rider was at the pin the whole time: the rider's track shows 54 fixes, all 54 qualifying, with a maximum distance of 8.6 m from the pickup point and zero speed throughout, so the rider was stationary at the pickup while the driver's car was elsewhere.

The rider sent a locating message at 22:49:35 ('where are you? i dont see any car') and the driver did not reply within 120 seconds - his only message came at 22:50:05, 30 seconds later but after the rider's message had already gone unanswered through the window - and no in-app call is recorded in trip_record.in_app_calls, so POL-NS-04 limbs (a) and (b) are met and the rider is exonerated with no driver compensation.

The fare ledger confirms the rider was charged SGD 4.50 with no refund issued (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.0), so the contested amount is live and a full refund of the cancellation-fee line is the remedy.

No traffic advisory covers the Bedok Interchange PHV bay in this window - the artifact is MISSING with weight 0.0 - so POL-NS-06 limb (i) is unavailable and the driver cannot accumulate dwell across intervals or excuse the shortfall on kerb-restriction grounds.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02710 is refunded in full to the rider. The driver is paid nothing, and the trip is recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver.

Why. The pickup was the Bedok Interchange PHV bay, a TRANSPORT_HUB, so the arrival radius is 150 m (POL-NS-02, read off EV-TRIP-02710). The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02710, weight 1.0, 100% coverage and no gaps) contains 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes across the whole trip and his closest approach to the pin is 517.4 m. The 'arrived' marker he set at 22:48:55 therefore places him more than 300 m from the pin and, with speeds of 28.8–63.0 km/h in the same trace, still in motion: under POL-NS-05 the marker is FALSE and does not start the waiting clock. Recomputing from the first qualifying in-geofence fix, there is none anywhere in the trip, so POL-NS-05(ii) applies — full refund of the SGD 4.50, no compensation, and the false-arrival referral above. POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails on the same evidence (the driver was never inside the 150 m geofence), and independently POL-NS-06 gives the same full refund because the in-geofence dwell is 0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02710.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — a 180-second shortfall.

Driver's advocate's claims. The wrong-entrance argument under POL-NS-03 is rejected: that clause requires the driver to be stationary within 400 m of the pin, and his minimum distance is 517.4 m, so the ceiling is not met and no goodwill payment arises. The driver's statement 'I arrived and waited, the rider did not come' is contradicted by his own telemetry (517 m to 5.2 km from the pin across the window) and is outweighed by it. The rider's presence on her own track (54 of 54 fixes qualifying inside the 200 m hub radius, mean 5.4 m) is accepted as a fact, but it does not by itself decide anything.

Rider's advocate's POL-NS-04 claims are rejected on their merits. Limbs (a) and (c) are met (locating message at 22:49:35; rider within 200 m throughout), but limb (b) fails: the driver DID reply in the chat at 22:50:05, 30 seconds after her message, and POL-NS-04 does not apply where the driver replied within 120 seconds, whatever the reply says. That clause therefore adds nothing here — the refund comes from POL-NS-05(ii), POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06 instead — and its failure changes no amount.

On compensation: the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in the trailing 30 days against 93 completed trips, a rate of 0.0215, both below the clause's thresholds), but the driver receives nothing because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 leaves the fee standing.

No escalation arises. The trace is complete, the chat log and fare ledger reconcile to the SGD 4.50 net fee, there is no clock skew, the arrival-marker conflict between the trip record and the trace is resolved by POL-NS-05, the counterparty-dispute counters are 0 and no profile trigger fires. Confidence is capped at 1.0 by the artifacts carrying the deciding facts (all at weight 1.0) and is set at 0.93. Nothing rests on the missing traffic advisory (EV-ADVIS-02710-01, weight 0.0); the two claims that cited it without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT code were discarded by the referee.

The monetary effect, SGD 4.50, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05) and so executes automatically on issue; either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04 within 30 days.
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival record: record trip TRP-02710 against driver DRV-09710 as a false-arrival event — the 22:48:55 'arrived' marker is false (the trace places the driver at least 517.4 m from the pickup pin and shows him moving at 28.8–63.0 km/h) and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip.

ruling.explanation:
Both of you: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02710. The charge does not stand, and the whole SGD 4.50 is refunded to the rider.

WHY. The only fact that matters for a no-show fee is whether the driver reached the pickup at Bedok Interchange PHV bay. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02710) carries a driver 'arrived' event at 22:48:55 and a driver cancellation at 22:53:55 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02710) contradicts him: his closest fix anywhere in the trip is 517.4 m from the pin, the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and 0.0 seconds of in-geofence dwell against the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB, and his distinct speeds run 28.8 to 63.0 km/h, i.e. still in motion. Under POL-NS-02, no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before the cancellation means the driver never arrived, POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails, and the rider gets a full refund. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result arithmetically: effective in-geofence dwell 0.0 seconds against the 180-second free waiting period in force, a shortfall of 180 seconds, so the fee is not chargeable.

WHY NOT THE OTHER ROUTES THE PARTIES ARGUED. Both sides argued POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance, but that clause's test is a stationary driver within 400 m of the pin and the ceiling is not met here: 517.4 m is outside it, so POL-NS-03 does not apply and no pin-ambiguity goodwill arises. Both sides also argued POL-NS-04 exoneration, and both read limb (b) wrong: it requires that the driver did NOT reply within 120 seconds of the rider's locating message. The rider's 'where are you? i dont see any car' was sent at 22:49:35 and the driver replied 'im here already' at 22:50:05, 30 seconds later. POL-NS-04 therefore does not apply at all, whatever the reply said, and its limb (c) rider-presence point (54 of 54 rider fixes qualifying, mean 5.4 m, max 8.6 m from the pin) never gets reached. It changes nothing: the refund comes from POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-06. The rider's presence is nonetheless confirmed and the driver's statement 'I arrived and waited' is contradicted by his own telemetry and corroborated by no admissible fix.

FALSE ARRIVAL MARKER. POL-NS-05 engages: at the 22:48:55 marker the driver was more than 300 m from the pin (he was never closer than 517 m all trip) and moving. With no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere, POL-NS-05(ii) refunds the fee in full, pays no compensation, and requires the trip to be recorded as a false-arrival event against the driver — that is the referral below.

DRIVER COMPENSATION: none. POL-NS-07 needs POL-NS-01 satisfied in full, and it is not, and POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displace it. The anti-farming check is not the reason for withholding it: 2 no-show terminations against 93 completed trips in 30 days is below both the count and the rate test.

AMOUNTS. The fare breakdown (EV-FARE-02710) shows total_charged SGD 4.50, all of it the cancellation-fee line, refund_issued_sgd 0.0 and payment_status CHARGED. That SGD 4.50 is refunded. The monetary effect is below the SGD 8.00 automatic execution threshold, so it executes on issue.

NO ESCALATION. Nothing in the record is impaired under POL-NS-08 (100% trace coverage, no gaps, chat message count matches the trip record, fare line reconciles to the net figure in force). No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival without a clause resolving the conflict — POL-NS-05 resolves the marker against the trace. No POL-NS-09 profile trigger fires. The deciding fact carries weight 1.0 on both artifacts that support it, so the confidence cap does not bite.

CLAIMS. Accepted: the arrival-radius failure (POL-NS-02 / POL-NS-01(b)); the 180-second dwell shortfall (POL-NS-06); the false arrival marker (POL-NS-05); the rider-presence facts; the SGD 4.50 fare figure; and the anti-farming result. Rejected on the merits: the POL-NS-03 wrong-entrance claim (400 m ceiling fails) and the POL-NS-04 exoneration claim (the driver did reply within 120 seconds). Two claims were discarded by the referee before I saw them, both for citing the MISSING traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02710-01 without naming its MISSING_ARTIFACT issue code.

ruling.explanation: To both parties. The SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full, and no compensation is paid to the driver. What the record shows: the GPS trace (EV-GPS-02710) places the driver no closer than 517.4 m to the pickup pin at Bedok Interchange — a TRANSPORT_HUB, arrival radius 150 m — at any point in the trip, with 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 s; the rider's own track places her within 8.6 m of the pin on 54 of 54 fixes, stationary throughout. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02710) shows a driver-pressed 'arrived' marker at 22:48:55, cancellation by the driver at 22:53:55 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, and free_wait_sec of 180. On the claims: (1) POL-NS-02 and POL-NS-01 limb (b) — accepted: there is no qualifying in-radius fix in the 15 minutes before cancellation, so the driver never arrived, limb (b) fails and the fee is not chargeable. (2) POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) — rejected: that clause reaches only stationary points within 400 m of the pin, and the driver's closest approach is 517.4 m, beyond the ceiling, so he did not reach the pickup point at all; POL-NS-03's pin-ambiguity goodwill could not apply in any event, as registered_pickup_points is 1 and not 2 or more. (3) POL-NS-05 — accepted: at the 22:48:55 marker the trace puts the driver more than 300 m from the pin (517.4 m), so the marker is false and the waiting clock cannot run from it; with no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, limb (ii) refunds the fee in full, pays no compensation, and records a false-arrival event against the driver — the referral above. (4) POL-NS-06 — accepted on its own terms: effective in-geofence dwell 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force, a shortfall of 180 s, so the fee is refunded whether or not the rider was present; limb (i) accumulation is unavailable because no traffic advisory covers this bay (EV-ADVIS-02710-01 is MISSING), but nothing turns on it. (5) POL-NS-04 (rider exoneration) — rejected: limb (b) requires that the driver did not reply within 120 seconds of the rider's locating message, and he replied at 22:50:05, 30 seconds after her 22:49:35 message, so the clause does not apply and the content of the reply is irrelevant to it; the rider's refund does not depend on this clause, because it follows from POL-NS-02, POL-NS-05 and POL-NS-06. (6) POL-NS-07 — the anti-farming check does not trip (2 no-show terminations in 30 days, 2/93 = 0.02, both below the thresholds), so there is no escalation on that ground; no driver compensation is payable because POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 provides a payout on these facts. (7) The driver's statement that he 'arrived and waited' is not accepted: it is contradicted by his own telemetry across the whole window and is corroborated by no admissible fix. Amount and confidence: the refund is the cancellation-fee line only — EV-FARE-02710 shows cancellation_fee 4.50, total_charged 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00. The deciding fact (the driver's position) is carried by EV-GPS-02710 at weight 1.00 and by the trip record at 1.00, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.00; I set confidence at 0.95. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger applies: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, POL-NS-05 resolves the conflict between the arrival marker and the trace, the anti-farming check does not trip, and no impaired artifact carries the deciding fact. Two claims that cited the missing advisory (EV-ADVIS-02710-01) were discarded by the referee for not naming its issue code and are listed in the audit record. The monetary effect (SGD 4.50) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00, so it executes automatically, and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
Rider and driver: the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee is refunded to the rider in full and no driver compensation is payable.

What the record shows. The driver's own GPS trace (EV-GPS-02710, weight 1.0 — 64 fixes at 10-second cadence, 100% coverage, no gaps) never places the vehicle inside the 150 m arrival radius for this TRANSPORT_HUB pickup: the derived arrival block reports 0 qualifying in-geofence fixes and a longest qualifying run of 0.0 seconds. His closest approach to the pin (Bedok Interchange PHV bay) over the whole trace is 517.4 m, his mean distance is 1,618.8 m, and his speeds run to 63.0 km/h. The trip record (EV-TRIP-02710, weight 1.0) carries a driver-pressed arrival marker (arrival_marker BUTTON) at 22:48:55 and a driver cancellation at 22:53:55 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW.

Why the fee falls. POL-NS-02: there is no qualifying in-radius fix at any point in the 15 minutes before cancellation, so the driver is not deemed to have arrived and POL-NS-01 limb (b) fails. The wrong-entrance arguments run by both advocates under POL-NS-03 fail on arithmetic — that clause's ceiling is 400 m from the pin and the driver's closest fix is 517.4 m, so this is not a wrong face of the same venue but a driver who was never at the pickup; POL-NS-03 does not govern. POL-NS-05: the 'arrived' marker at 22:48:55 is false, because the trace places the vehicle far beyond 300 m from the pin and in motion at 28.8–63.0 km/h, so the waiting clock cannot run from it; with no qualifying in-geofence fix anywhere in the trip, limb (ii) refunds the fee in full with no compensation and records the false-arrival event. POL-NS-06 reaches the same result independently: effective in-geofence dwell 0.0 s against the 180 s free waiting period in force for this trip, a 180 s shortfall. Accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) is unavailable because the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02710-01 is MISSING (weight 0.0), and the shortfall therefore stands unexcused.

The rider-exoneration claims. POL-NS-04 is argued by both sides but does not apply. Limb (a) is met — the rider's message at 22:49:35 ('where are you? i dont see any car') is a locating message. Limb (b) is not met: the driver replied at 22:50:05, 30 seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, and POL-NS-04 expressly does not apply where the driver replied within 120 seconds, whatever the reply says. The rider-presence evidence (54 of 54 rider fixes qualifying, mean 5.4 m and maximum 8.6 m from the pin, stationary) is accepted as fact but does not change the outcome: the fee falls on the driver's position, not the rider's, and limb (c) alone decides nothing.

The driver's side. The counterparty statement ('I arrived and waited, the rider did not come') carries no weight multiplier and is directly contradicted by the driver's own trace; it is not accepted. No driver compensation is payable: POL-NS-01 is not satisfied in full, POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displace it, and POL-NS-07 therefore does not engage. The anti-farming check does not trip on either advocate's figures (no_show_terminations_30d 2, below the count of 4; 2/93 = 0.0215, below the rate of 0.08) — but that is not the reason compensation fails; the failure of POL-NS-01 limb (b) is. No POL-NS-09 escalation trigger fires: POL-NS-05 resolves the only apparent conflict (arrival marker against trace), so limb (b) is not engaged; there is no anti-farming trip and no repeat-dispute pattern (both disputes_with_counterparty_90d are 0); and confidence is above the 0.70 floor. The POL-NS-03(ii) pin-ambiguity goodwill does not arise, because it requires stationary fixes within 400 m of the pin and there are none.

Money and effect. The fare ledger EV-FARE-02710 (weight 1.0) shows the cancellation-fee line at SGD 4.50, total charged SGD 4.50, payment_status CHARGED and refund_issued_sgd 0.00; that line, and only that line, is refunded. The monetary effect of SGD 4.50 is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold (POL-GEN-05), so the refund executes automatically on issue, subject to the appeal route under POL-GEN-04.

Confidence is 0.93, capped at 1.0 by the artifacts that carry the deciding facts (EV-GPS-02710 and EV-TRIP-02710, each weight 1.0); neither the missing advisory nor any other artifact relied on is impaired under POL-NS-08(a)–(d).
referrals: POL-NS-05(ii) — false-arrival record: driver DRV-09710 pressed the 'arrived' marker at 2026-08-19T22:48:55+08:00 while the GPS trace placed the vehicle more than 517.4 m from the pickup pin and moving at 28.8–63.0 km/h, and no qualifying in-geofence fix exists anywhere in the trip; the trip is to be recorded as a false-arrival event against this driver.
